jamal (release-ops): FYI: We're scheduling a 'quiet window' for the KV/prefix-cache shard migration next Wed 00:30-04:30 UTC. This is a soft freeze: emergency security fixes allowed, schema/DB migrations are NOT allowed. Please read the short ops notes and ack if you own any rollout lanes. :mega:

lina (eng-runtime): Acknowledged. We'll freeze runtime image pushes and pin runtime-config to avoid dynamic quantization changes.

ian (eng-platform): Platform note: no terraform applies touching production networking or pool sizes from 23:30-05:30 UTC. We'll create an infra hold ticket so automated CI is blocked.

rachel (eng-sre): Oncall: I'll run a dry-run preflight at -8h and a full preflight at -30m. We'll extend trace retention +72h for the migration and enable high-card latency buckets.

nina (product): Product asks teams to ensure any scheduled feature flag ramps are paused during the window. If you need a quick toggle for a hotfix, follow exception flow.

jamal (release-ops): Cutover plan (brief): 3-stage canary with health gating. Stage durations: 8m -> 12m -> 30m. Automated gate checks: error-rate, p99 latency, and tail mem usage. Rollback on any gate failure.

release-bot: SCHEDULED: kv-shard-cutover-2026 at 00:45 UTC (jamal).

lina (eng-runtime): Heads-up: long-lived websocket sessions may see prefix key mismatch for ~30s during switchover. We'll enable read-through fallback and serve stale prefixed keys for 60s to reduce 5xx.

ian (eng-platform): Handy commands to validate canary targets before cutover:

```
rgctl describe --env=prod --group=kv-cutover-2026
rgctl check-health --group=kv-cutover-2026 --thresholds=default
```

rachel (eng-sre): Preflight checklist (condensed):
- smoke tests green on canary images
- perf run: p50/p95/p99 vs baseline
- alerts wired and runbook linked
- rollback artefact uploaded

jamal (release-ops): Runbook + exception request form posted: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cutover-2026 and https://redwood.internal/forms/release-exception. Exception must include owner, rollback steps, and test group sign-off.

nina (product): Client comms: we'll wait 90 minutes post-100% canary before pushing client banner. If the window extends we'll hold further comms.

oncall-bot: ONCALL ROTATION: rachel is primary for window; backup is marcus. PagerDuty channel: #incidents.

lina (eng-runtime): Small runtime ask: please avoid tagging new model variants that change cache key schema for 24h before cutover. That's been the most common accidental cause.

jamal (release-ops): Exception process quick reminder: file the form, ping me + rachel in thread, and include a short rollback playbook. We'll fast-track morning-of exceptions only.

ian (eng-platform): If you need to sanity-check network routes, use the staging route mirror with this command:
```
rgctl mirror --from=prod --to=mirror-kv-cutover
rgctl compare --group mirror-kv-cutover --metrics latency,errors
```

rachel (eng-sre): If anything drops below the gate during canary, we will auto-pause and open an incident channel. Have a rollback tag ready.

jamal (release-ops): Final: quiet window Wed 00:30-04:30 UTC. Canary start 00:45 UTC. Please ack if you have rollout responsibilities or exceptions. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
